app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

description.example: Everything You Need To Know About Worlds!

first_frame_time.description: FirstFrameTime is the UTC time of the recording's first frame, when the upstream knows it.

offset.description: Offset is the upstream's alignment offset for the recording in milliseconds.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns every completed match of one tournament with final game wins and the game ids and VOD references for each game. An empty list is valid for a tournament that has not started.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Numeric tournament id from lolesports-tournaments
parameters.name: tournament_id

get.summary: League of Legends Esports completed matches

get.description: Returns one match: league, tournament, teams with game wins, best-of strategy, each game's id, number, state (`unneeded`, `unstarted`, `inProgress`, `completed`), blue/red side assignment and VODs, plus broadcast streams. Use a game `id` with lolesports-game-window or lolesports-game-details. An unknown match id returns not found.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Numeric match id from lolesports-schedule, lolesports-live or lolesports-standings
parameters.name: match_id

get.summary: League of Legends Esports match detail

get.description: Returns per-player detail frames for one game: level, KDA, gold, creep score, kill participation, damage share, wards, attack damage, ability power, armor, magic resistance, final items, rune ids and skill order. Use participant ids from lolesports-game-window metadata. The same `starting_time` rule as lolesports-game-window applies.

parameters.description: Numeric game id from lolesports-event
parameters.name: game_id

parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp whose seconds are divisible by 10; frames begin there
parameters.name: starting_time

parameters.description: Participant numbers 1 to 10 joined by underscores, for example 1_2_3
parameters.name: participant_ids

get.summary: League of Legends Esports player game details

get.description: Returns the lolesports live-stats window for one game: patch, blue and red team and player metadata (champion, role, summoner name) and roughly ten seconds of frames with team gold, kills, towers, inhibitors, barons, dragons and per-player level, KDA, creep score and health. `game_state` is `in_game`, `paused` or `finished`. For a game in progress omit `starting_time` for the latest window; for a completed game pass a timestamp inside the game.

parameters.description: Numeric game id from lolesports-event
parameters.name: game_id

parameters.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp whose seconds are divisible by 10; frames begin there
parameters.name: starting_time

get.summary: League of Legends Esports live game window

get.description: Returns the League of Legends Esports Global Power Rankings (GPR): every ranked team with rank, GPR score, Elo, previous rank and rank change, home league, match and game records, average opponent GPR and the tournaments counted with each result and placement. `season` selects `current` (the running year, default) or the Worlds snapshots `2025` and `2024`; `league` keeps one home league's teams and `history` adds the daily GPR history points. The response lists the seasons and home leagues available.

parameters.description: Ranking snapshot; one of current, 2025, 2024; defaults to current
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Home league slug from the leagues list of the response, for example lck
parameters.name: league

parameters.description: Number of teams to return, 1 to 200, best rank first; defaults to all
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Add each team's GPR history points
parameters.name: history

get.summary: League of Legends Global Power Rankings

get.description: Returns every league on lolesports.com with its numeric `id`, `slug`, name, region, image and display status (`force_selected`, `selected`, `not_selected`, `hidden`). Use a league `id` with lolesports-schedule or lolesports-tournaments. Region labels are upstream values such as `EMEA`, `KOREA`, `CHINA`, `NORTH AMERICA` and `INTERNATIONAL`.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

get.description: Returns matches currently in progress across all leagues, in the same shape as lolesports-schedule events. An empty list is valid when no league is playing. Pair a returned match id with lolesports-event to get game ids, then lolesports-game-window for live frames.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

get.summary: League of Legends Esports live matches

get.description: Returns the articles listed on the League of Legends Esports news page: title, summary, link, publication time, banner image, authors and whether the item links out to another site (a video or a store page). The page shows up to the newest 100 items and has no category, tag or paging controls; `hl` selects the site language and `limit` keeps the newest items only.

parameters.description: Site language; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, el-GR, en-AU, en-GB, en-PH, en-SG, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, id-ID, it-IT, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, ro-RO, ru-RU, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Number of newest articles to return, 1 to 100; defaults to all the page lists
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns the match schedule around today: start time, state (`unstarted`, `inProgress`, `completed`), block name, league, teams, outcome and game wins, and best-of strategy. Optionally filter with `league_id`. Follow `older_page_token` for past results and `newer_page_token` for later fixtures; a missing token means that direction is exhausted.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Numeric league id from lolesports-leagues, or up to 10 comma-separated ids to combine leagues; omit for all leagues
parameters.name: league_id

parameters.description: older_page_token or newer_page_token copied from a previous response
parameters.name: page_token

get.description: Returns the League of Legends esports calendar since 2011, newest first: every season with its splits (start and end time, region) and the tournaments played in each split with their league. Use a tournament `id` with lolesports-standings or lolesports-completed-events and a league `id` with lolesports-tournaments. `season_id` (taken from an earlier response) returns one season; `region` keeps only splits of one region and `league_id` keeps only that league's tournaments, both applied after the fetch. The unfiltered list is large (about 300 KB). A season id that does not exist returns not found.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Numeric season id from an earlier lolesports-seasons response; omit for every season
parameters.name: season_id

parameters.description: Split region, case-insensitive; one of AMERICAS, BRAZIL, CHINA, COMMONWEALTH OF INDEPENDENT STATES, EMEA, EUROPE, GLOBAL, HONG KONG, MACAU, TAIWAN, INTERNATIONAL, JAPAN, KOREA, LATIN AMERICA, LATIN AMERICA NORTH, LATIN AMERICA SOUTH, NORTH AMERICA, OCEANIA, REGIONAL, SOUTHEAST ASIA, TURKEY, VIETNAM
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Numeric league id from lolesports-leagues; keeps only that league's tournaments
parameters.name: league_id

get.summary: League of Legends Esports seasons and splits

get.description: Returns one tournament's stages (for example Regular Season, Playoffs), each with sections of matches and ordered team rankings with win-loss records. Playoff brackets include `previous_match_ids` that link rounds; `rounds=true` also names each bracket round. Use match ids with lolesports-event.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Numeric tournament id from lolesports-tournaments
parameters.name: tournament_id

parameters.description: true adds each section's id and type (group or bracket) and bracket round names with their match ids; costs a second upstream call; false or omitted keeps the default response
parameters.name: rounds

get.description: Returns teams with slug, code, status (`active`, `archived`), home league and the roster of players (summoner name, real name, role `top`, `jungle`, `mid`, `bottom`, `support`). Look up one team with `slug` or search with `q`; results are sorted by name and paged. The slug of every team is available from lolesports-standings and lolesports-schedule.

parameters.description: Language for names and labels; one of cs-CZ, de-DE, en-US, es-ES, es-MX, fr-FR, hu-HU, ja-JP, ko-KR, pl-PL, pt-BR, th-TH, tr-TR, vi-VN, zh-TW; defaults to en-US
parameters.name: hl

parameters.description: Exact team slug such as t1 or g2-esports; takes precedence over q
parameters.name: slug

parameters.name: status

get.summary: League of Legends Esports teams and rosters
